posts.title: Origin of a Deadhead
posts.description: NPR is doing a series of podcasts and stories on Deadheads: Legacy and Future of the Grateful Dead fandom

posts.title: Thoughts on Vegas
posts.description: Collette and I just returned from three nights in Las Vegas, and we probably won’t go back. The trip was built around tickets to see Dead & Company at the Sphere on May 15, 2025. The show was great and the Sphere was amazing — that experience alone would’ve made the trip worth it.
